items.title: Goldman Sachs (GS) Enters Talks For Controlling Stake In South Korean Mobility App
items.summary: Goldman Sachs Group (NYSE:GS) is reportedly in talks to buy a controlling stake in South Korean navigation app operator Tmap Mobility. The potential deal would give Goldman Sachs greater exposure to Asia's digital mobility market, including location and transit services in South Korea. Tmap Mobility is linked to SK Square's broader push into AI and semiconductors, which could align with Goldman's digital infrastructure ambitions in the region.
